lines.name: l1
lines.text: [whispering, scared] Shift twenty. Patient thirteen passed every check.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: [whispering, scared] Temperature, normal. Pulse, normal. He just... never blinked.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: [whispering, scared] At three nineteen, camera three lost him.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: [whispering, scared] Camera eight is the security room. I'm the only one in it.
